final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as their docstrings specify:

- In bookings/billing.py, I changed billable_blocks to raise ValueError for negative minutes and to always round up partial blocks instead of using round().
- In bookings/schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument. It now creates a new list if none is provided, ensuring separate calls do not share state.
- In bookings/timeutil.py, I improved parse_duration to support all documented formats (e.g., "1h", "45m", "1:30", bare numbers) and to raise ValueError only if none match.

These changes align the code with the specifications in the docstrings and should make all tests pass.
